methodologyNotes: Roster of nine real, currently-sold or recently-released mini PCs (2023-2025): Apple Mac mini (M4), Beelink SER8, Minisforum UM790 Pro, Geekom A8, Asus NUC 14 Pro, Acer Revo Box AI, GMKtec NucBox K8, Beelink GTi14 Ultra, and Minisforum MS-01. All nine were independently re-verified on 2026-06-15 against manufacturer product/spec pages (apple.com/support.apple.com, bee-link.com, store.minisforum.com, geekompc.com, asus.com/shop.asus.com, store.acer.com, gmktec.com) and reputable reviews (Notebookcheck, Liliputing, ServeTheHome, CNX Software). priceUsd is the lowest verifiable published US price for the model/config named in priceNote (street/sale where MSRP unstable for white-box brands); storage_type records SSD interface; ethernet reports highest-speed wired NIC; wifi_standard is the standard the manufacturer lists for the included card; dimensions_mm are W x D x H. Corrections made vs draft: Geekom A8 base CPU is Ryzen 7 8745HS (not 8845HS); GMKtec K8 official page lists Wi-Fi 6 (not 6E) and the draft's K8/K8-Plus Wi-Fi note was fabricated and removed; Asus NUC 14 Pro starting price corrected $394->$434 (ASUS US shop); Minisforum MS-01 priceUsd corrected $549->$819 (the $549 figure was the i5-12600H barebone, not the named i9-13900H); Beelink GTi14 Ultra priced to the Ultra 9 185H sold at the cited source ($1,049); Mac mini HDMI noted as 2.1. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
